bridge.title: The Bear's Bridge
bridge.prompt: 🐻 The bear needs to cross the river. Build a bridge!

wood.text: Wood is strong and light. The bridge holds the bear and it crosses safely!

stone.text: Stone is too heavy for a simple bridge and it collapses before the bear crosses.

rope.text: Rope alone sags under the bear's weight — it falls into the water!

paper.text: The paper tears as soon as the bear puts a paw on it.

tower.title: The Tallest Tower
tower.prompt: 🚩 Build a tower tall enough to touch the flag!

wood.text: Wooden blocks stack up firmly — the tower reaches the flag!

stone.text: Stone is heavy but stable at the base — the tower stands firm and reaches the flag!

rope.text: Rope can't stand up on its own — the tower never rises.

paper.text: Paper bends under the weight and the tower collapses.

boat.title: The Floating Boat
boat.prompt: ⛵ Build a boat that floats and carries the toys to the other shore!

wood.text: Wood floats really well — the boat sails smoothly!

stone.text: Stone is too dense and sinks as soon as it touches the water.

rope.text: Rope doesn't form a hull — water gets in and the boat sinks.

paper.text: Paper soaks up water, goes soft, and dissolves.

dam.title: The Beaver's Dam
dam.prompt: 🦫 The beaver wants to hold back the river. Build a dam!

wood.text: Wood lets water seep through small gaps — the dam gives way.

stone.text: Stacked stone is heavy and forms a solid wall — the dam holds the river back!

rope.text: Rope can't stop water, which slips right through the strands.

paper.text: The paper dissolves as soon as it touches the water.

catapult.title: The Catapult
catapult.prompt: 🎯 Build a catapult to launch the ball over the wall!

wood.text: The wooden arm is strong and bendy — it flexes and flings the ball far away!

stone.text: Stone is too stiff to bend like an arm — it can't launch anything.

rope.text: Rope is flexible but doesn't push the ball — it just falls to the side.

paper.text: Paper bends and tears, with no force to launch the ball.

crane.title: The Lifting Crane
crane.prompt: 🏗️ Build a crane to lift the heavy box!

wood.text: The wooden arm is light and strong — it lifts the box with ease!

stone.text: Stone is too heavy for its own arm to rise — the crane can't move.

rope.text: Rope bends without a rigid arm — it can't lift the box.

paper.text: The paper tears the moment the box is attached.

seesaw.title: The Rabbit's Seesaw
seesaw.prompt: 🐰 The rabbit and the squirrel want to play on a seesaw. Build one!

wood.text: Wood is stiff and light — the seesaw balances perfectly up and down!

stone.text: Stone is too heavy on one side — the seesaw can't go up at all.

rope.text: Rope bends and can't form a firm plank — no one can sit on it.

paper.text: Paper bends as soon as someone sits down.

slide.title: The Mountain Slide
slide.prompt: 🐿️ The squirrel wants to slide down the mountain for fun. Build a slide!

wood.text: Wood is smooth and sturdy — the squirrel glides gently all the way down!

stone.text: Stone is rough and too heavy to shape into a smooth ramp.

rope.text: Rope doesn't form a flat surface — there's nothing to slide on.

paper.text: Paper tears under the squirrel's weight as it slides.

kite.title: The Paper Kite
kite.prompt: 🐦 The little bird wants a friend to fly beside it. Build a kite!

wood.text: Wood is too heavy — the kite never leaves the ground.

stone.text: Stone falls straight down, with no chance of flying.

rope.text: Rope alone has no surface to catch the wind.

paper.text: Paper is light and catches the wind easily — the kite soars high into the sky!

windmill.title: The Windmill
windmill.prompt: 🐭 The mouse wants to see the blades spin in the wind. Build a windmill!

wood.text: Wooden blades are too heavy — the wind can't move them.

stone.text: Stone doesn't budge even in the strongest wind.

rope.text: Rope has no surface for the wind to push against.

paper.text: Paper blades are light and spin easily with just a gentle breeze!

zipline.title: The Jungle Zipline
zipline.prompt: 🐒 The monkey wants to zoom from tree to tree. Build a zipline!

wood.text: Stiff wood can't be tied to the trees to form a taut line.

stone.text: Stone can't be stretched between the trees.

rope.text: The rope stretched tight between the trees holds the monkey's weight, who glides happily to the other side!

paper.text: Paper tears the moment the monkey hangs from it.

swing.title: The Tree Swing
swing.prompt: 🐶 The dog wants to swing from a tree in the garden. Build a swing!

wood.text: Stiff wood can't bend around the branch to hold the swing up.

stone.text: Stone is too heavy and breaks the tree branch.

rope.text: Rope is strong and flexible — it wraps around the branch and the swing works perfectly!

paper.text: Paper rips the moment someone sits on the swing.

wall.title: The Castle Wall
wall.prompt: 🐴 The horse wants to protect the castle from strong winds. Build a wall!

wood.text: Wood is too light and the strong wind knocks the wall down.

stone.text: Stacked stone blocks form a heavy, solid wall that stands up to the wind!

rope.text: Rope doesn't form a wall — the wind passes right through.

paper.text: Paper blows away with the very first gust of wind.

well.title: The Village Well
well.prompt: 🐔 The hen wants fresh water from the village. Build a well!

wood.text: Wood rots in the damp earth and the well collapses.

stone.text: Stones stacked in a circle form firm walls that don't cave in with the surrounding earth!

rope.text: Rope alone can't hold back the earth around the hole.

paper.text: Paper dissolves in the damp earth.

waterwheel.title: The Mill's Water Wheel
waterwheel.prompt: 🐟 The fish wants to see the wheel spin with the river's current. Build a water wheel!

wood.text: Wooden paddles are light but strong — the river's current pushes them and the wheel spins nonstop!

stone.text: Stone is too heavy — the river's current can't move it.

rope.text: Rope has no paddles for the water to push.

paper.text: Paper dissolves the moment it touches the flowing water.

parachute.title: The Teddy Bear's Parachute
parachute.prompt: 🧸 The teddy bear wants to jump off the roof without getting hurt. Build a parachute!

wood.text: Wood is too heavy and falls straight down, without slowing the fall at all.

stone.text: Stone falls like a rock — with no chance of floating in the air.

rope.text: Rope alone has no surface to catch the air.

paper.text: Paper is light and opens up like a sheet, catching the air and floating gently down to the ground!
